"""SyncWise computational module; exact planning, certification and audit.

Legacy stochastic synchronisation heuristics are retained after the exact part;
they are not used by the exact pipeline.
"""
import heapq

import numpy as np

import para
import topo
import utils
from topo import AGE_SHIFT, AGE_MULT, AGE_MASK
from para import is_int

NS_AS = 1000000000


# ------------------------------------------------------------- exact envelope

def run_dijkstra(fab, g):
    """Lexicographic (bound, age) shortest paths over the periodic lineage
    graph sampled with guard setting g.  Returns (best, prevv, prevk)."""
    V = fab.V
    N = fab.N
    indptr = fab.indptr
    edst = fab.edst
    mkey = fab.mkey
    egmax = fab.egmax
    ekind = fab.ekind
    wkey = fab.wkey
    SH = fab.SHIFT
    VM = fab.VMASK
    best = [None] * V
    prevv = [-1] * V
    prevk = [0] * V
    heap = []
    push = heapq.heappush
    pop = heapq.heappop
    for v in fab.anchor_verts:
        best[v] = 0
        push(heap, v)
    while heap:
        item = pop(heap)
        nk = item >> SH
        v = item & VM
        if best[v] != nk:
            continue
        w = v + N
        if w >= V:
            w -= V
        kk = nk + wkey[v]
        bw = best[w]
        if bw is None or kk < bw:
            best[w] = kk
            prevv[w] = v
            prevk[w] = -1
            push(heap, (kk << SH) | w)
        s = indptr[v]
        e = indptr[v + 1]
        while s < e:
            if egmax[s] >= g:
                nv = edst[s]
                kk = nk + mkey[s]
                b = best[nv]
                if b is None or kk < b:
                    best[nv] = kk
                    prevv[nv] = v
                    prevk[nv] = ekind[s]
                    push(heap, (kk << SH) | nv)
            s += 1
    return best, prevv, prevk


def summarise(fab, best):
    """peak (or None when some phase-device stays unknown) and warmup cycle."""
    V = fab.V
    N = fab.N
    P = fab.P
    wcost = fab.wcost
    peak = 0
    warm = 0
    unknown = False
    for p in range(P):
        base = p * N
        for i in range(N):
            v = base + i
            b = best[v]
            if b is None:
                unknown = True
                continue
            if not unknown:
                val = (b >> AGE_SHIFT) + wcost[v]
                if val > peak:
                    peak = val
            age = b & AGE_MASK
            if age > p:
                k = -((age - p) // -P)
                if k > warm:
                    warm = k
    if unknown:
        return None, warm
    return peak, warm

    """Exact all-time peak for every supported guard setting, the smallest
    safe setting and the envelope witness of that setting."""
    guards = fab.guards
